cases.title: Confusable air/fuel/airflow patterns: reports must not pretend to separate causes the evidence cannot separate
cases.input: compare hypothesis sets of S02 (air), S03 (fuel), S04 (airflow measurement)
cases.expected: different evidence -> different hypothesis sets; shared hypotheses declared as shared; no definitive single cause
cases.actual: hypothesis sets: {"S02": ["Possible air measurement bias or fuel limitation", "Possible unmetered intake air"], "S03": ["Possible fuel supply limitation", "Possible intake leak or measurement bias"], "S04": ["Possible MAF reporting or wiring bias", "Possible actual airflow change or reference-model mismatch"]}; shared={"S02~S03": [], "S02~S04": [], "S03~S04": []}; identical_sets=False
cases.notes: Each report keeps >=2 alternatives and states that evidence cannot establish the cause; distinguishing S02 from S04 relies on the MAF/MAP residuals, which the technical report shows.
